# MDE v1.6.8

## Features

- The desktop app now opens directly into the Markdown editor workspace, with the ordinary file explorer, AI actions, and Agent Chat available.

## Bug Fixes

- Retired Automation Flow state, including malformed JSON and stale runtime ownership records, no longer participates in desktop startup.
- Old Automation Flow authoring metadata is ignored by ordinary Chat context handling; literal text in Markdown documents is preserved.

## Breaking Changes

- Removed Automation Center, Automation Flows sidebar controls, flow authoring context, schedules, discovery, task management, execution, and run-history UI.
- Removed Automation Flow IPC/preload APIs, the private automation-flow package, and the bundled automation-flow-helper skill.
- Existing flow, executor, task, archive, history, lock, and owner files remain on disk without migration or cleanup. Existing user-global helper links are left untouched and may point to retired targets.
- Old flow Markdown files can still be opened and edited as ordinary documents. Flow execution is no longer available in this version.

## Maintenance

- Removed the retired runtime, launch handling, package aliases, dependencies, component ids, and translations.
- Retained ordinary workspace/file windows, Markdown editing and saving, AI actions, Agent Chat, updates, CLI registration, and standalone development skills.
- Updated release metadata for the workspace, desktop app, and changed private Agent Chat package to 1.6.8. No workspace package is published to a registry.
- Added unit, integration, and desktop E2E coverage for the reduced app surfaces and preservation of legacy data.
- Corrected the existing history E2E to expand the toolbar's existing overflow control when needed, while retaining preview, restore, and disk assertions.

## Documentation/User Manual

- Updated the Chinese manual to reflect the editor-only desktop and explain retained legacy files.
- Refreshed all nine manual screenshots through the real Electron E2E screenshot workflow.
- A nonblocking empty table header in the component reference remains deferred from independent review.

## Verification

- Passed `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run build`, and `pnpm run docs:build`.
- Passed 450 unit tests, 194 integration tests, and 59 Agent Chat package tests.
- Passed the owning desktop full test entry, including 64 desktop E2Es and the editor-performance smoke. This exercises the same E2E command as the root entry.
- Passed the release-workflow coverage check: 703 tests, 87.67% lines/statements, 83.17% branches, and 91.46% functions.
- Legacy-data coverage verifies byte-identical retained files and unchanged installed helper links after startup, editing, reload, and shutdown.
- Independent whole-change review found no Critical or Important issues.
- A fresh exploratory desktop round passed for the removal scope, covering usability, performance, response speed, and visual quality with Unicode/nested paths, language switching, ordinary Chat, and preserved legacy files.
- Manual screenshots were regenerated through the Electron workflow; the manual build and Git whitespace checks passed.

## Artifacts

- The GitHub Actions Release workflow publishes macOS DMG/ZIP artifacts and a Windows NSIS installer with updater metadata.
- macOS signing and notarization remain optional. Unsigned macOS artifacts are expected when Apple signing secrets are not configured.
